text:
incident-bot: PAGE: High packet loss observed from clients to edge pop eu-south (metric spike on edge-loss-rate > 15%)
Priya R.: seeing same in dashboards — APDEX and success_rate down for a subset of prefixes. alerting customers with degraded streams now :rotating_light:
Marco V.: oncall-net, can you take? looks like BGP+last-mile maybe, traceroutes showing hops 10-20% loss after our edge.
oncall-net: taking. initial look: multiple traceroutes show consistent loss at ISP handoff (AS64500 border). opening carrier ticket.
Ash K.: Rolling a mitigation; will try quick traffic steering to nearby eu-west1 pop. If we can shift ~40% of traffic it'll buy time.
cdn-ops-bot: CDN routing policy applied: steering-policy=eu-west1-failover weight=40% (policy id rp-9832). Monitoring for 5m.
Jordan S.: copy — running fastcheck set: 
```
traceroute -q 3 -m 20 93.184.216.34
1 10.0.0.1 0.4 ms
... 8 203.0.113.45 12 ms 15 ms 14 ms
9 * * *
10 198.51.100.2 30 ms 28 ms 32 ms
```
loss kicks at hop 9-10 consistently.
Priya R.: customers affected: streaming customers in EU-south region (5 customers flagged), two enterprise customers seeing reconnects.
Lina C. - CS: I've notified CS leads for impacted accounts and opened support tickets. Sending standard customer message draft now.
Marco V.: carrier ticket number 987654 opened with provider AS64500 — they confirm degraded handoff due to a regional fiber maintenance overruns. ETA unknown.
oncall-net: tried contact with alternate IX peer, requesting temporary BGP path via AS64444, waiting for auth.
Ash K.: temporary measure: enabled prefix suppression for small prefixes and announced aggregate via eu-west1 to reduce path through eu-south edge. Will monitor for unintended collateral.
Priya R.: dashboards show steering started — packet loss for many flows dropped to ~3% within 6 minutes. latency bumped ~10ms for those routed via eu-west1.
Jordan S.: running capture on edge host — here's tcpdump snippet (redacted):
```
15:23:01.123 IP 198.51.100.23 > 10.0.0.5: Flags [P.], seq 12345:12389, ack 54321, win 1024
15:23:01.223 IP 198.51.100.23 > 10.0.0.5: frag 1
```
shows retransmits before steering.
cdn-ops-bot: policy rp-9832 confirmed healthy. tradeoffs: slight latency increase but success_rate improving :white_check_mark:
oncall-net: carrier replied — they've re-raised local maint and will patch in next 1-2 hours. They've requested we keep traffic off their handoff during remediation.
Marco V.: plan: keep steering active, request a controlled rollback plan if issues. After carrier patches, we'll gradually revert traffic in 10% steps while monitoring.
Ash K.: logged a runbook entry under incidents/2024-eu-south-fallover (internal) and assigned follow-up for full RCA, including asking carrier for maintenance timeline and link metrics.
Priya R.: current customer impact summary for postmortem: ~6% of total EU requests affected, 5 enterprise customers with transient reconnects, no data loss reported. CS already patched.
Lina C. - CS: customer updates sent. Two want a post-incident call — I've scheduled with engineering and their TAM for 16:30 UTC.
Jordan S.: adding retention capture and saving pcap to /mnt/forensics/incidents/2045601234.pcap
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation in place — reduced client-visible packet loss to <5%. next update in 30 minutes or on any regression.
Priya R.: thanks team. handing over to oncall-net for overnight observation — please escalate if loss >8% or if enterprise ticket escalates.
oncall-net: acknowledged, taking handoff. I'll monitor BGP/edge metrics and keep this thread updated.
